notes: Modified cash basis school district; basis recorded as cash. Governmental lines come from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp8, 10). Roll-forward: 1,524,744 + 4,757,806 - 4,101,070 - 38,092 (transfer to School Nutrition) = 2,143,388. beginning_cash/ending_cash are the governmental funds' beginning/ending fund balances (cash basis). Business-type: School Nutrition Fund (p12): beginning net position 150,104 + receipts 102,263 (operating 101,808 + interest 455) - disbursements 172,943 + transfers from General Fund 38,092 = 117,516. Statement of Receipts line 'Other' 101,206 split into rental 18,252, donations 450, refunds 15,471, miscellaneous 2,723, ESU 50, sale of property 2,250 (GF schedule pp13-15, sum 39,196) plus Activities Fund 'Other' 62,010 (p7); all tie. Hidden transfer: the General Fund column prints Regular Pupil Transportation 496,652, which includes a 200,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund (Depreciation Fund shows Transfers from General Fund 200,000, p17); the Adjustments column (p10) removes it, so the Total column is 296,652. Transfer cross-check: GF transfers 88,155 = Activities 50,063 + School Nutrition 38,092 (p21), plus 200,000 to Depreciation; in the Total column only the 38,092 to School Nutrition remains as a transfer (Activities and Depreciation are both governmental, so they net out). Detail: General Fund by function (budget schedule, pp13-16; no Exhibit N in the trimmed PDF); its printed Total Disbursements and Transfers 4,214,956 includes 88,155 transfers and the 200,000 split; transfers shown in other financing. Activities Fund per-account schedule (pp21-22) recorded instead of the one-line Activities budget schedule (p19, receipts 112,210 incl. transfers 50,063; disbursements 84,632). Zero-actual lines omitted from detail; Depreciation Fund 'Transfers to General Fund' actual 0 (budget 5,743) omitted. Receipt category assignment: Public Power District tax = other taxes. Combined fund-level disbursement lines State Categorical Programs and Federal Programs counted under instruction (review). Read pages 1-22 of 22
